subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album sending reuse existing `mediaUrls` as grouped album intent, add a separate album action/parameter, or stay deferred?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but selecting the public action and parameter shape affects the message-tool API and cannot be decided safely as cleanup automation.

options.title: Group eligible existing mediaUrls
options.body: Port or replace the draft so existing multi-media sends become Telegram albums when all items are groupable, with clear sequential fallback behavior.

options.title: Add an explicit album API
options.body: Adopt a separate action or parameter and pay the extra docs, tests, and compatibility review cost for the new public surface.

options.title: Defer album grouping
options.body: Keep current sequential delivery as supported behavior and close or supersede the linked draft only after maintainers state album grouping is out of scope.

recommendation.title: Group eligible existing mediaUrls
recommendation.body: Port or replace the draft so existing multi-media sends become Telegram albums when all items are groupable, with clear sequential fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already handled prior cleanup review on this tracker and is the clearest routing candidate for the API-shape decision from the available evidence.
